resources.string: Use edge gestures to open the volume popup or a panel. Touch areas receive touches even when hidden. Nudge does not read screen content.
Allow enabled handles to receive gestures.
Open Downloaded apps. Select Nudge handles and enable it.
In Accessibility, switch Nudge off and on. Check HyperOS setup if it disconnects again.
Request the phone volume popup without changing volume.
Request sent. Check whether the volume popup appeared.
You confirmed that the volume popup appeared.
The volume popup did not appear. Device compatibility needs investigation.
The volume request failed. Check Accessibility and try again.
An invisible touch area still receives touches. Keep it narrow to reduce interference with other controls.
The master switch must also be on.
Remove this handle and its three panels.
No handles. Select Add handle to create one.
The first handle receives touches where touch areas overlap.
This touch area overlaps another enabled handle.
Drag the touch area to move it. The phone guide passes touches through while you edit.
Connect Accessibility to show the guide on your phone.
The phone guide uses the current screen orientation. Rotate the phone to check landscape.
Allow this handle when the phone is sideways.
Keep separate landscape settings. Turning this off retains those values.
Editing shared settings. Bottom remains at the bottom after rotation.
Show the handle in previews and during use.
Enable Make handle visible to edit appearance. Saved values are retained.
Swipe inward, then release. Further swipes cycle through assigned stages while a panel or volume sequence is active.
Hold still for 500 ms, then release. For Swipe and hold, first swipe inward.
After a volume action, another swipe within this period advances the sequence.
Vibrate briefly when an action runs.
Allow this handle on the awake lock screen. Apps and settings require the normal unlock step.
Handles stay hidden while the screen is off. After reboot, unlock the phone once before use.
Hide this handle in selected apps. Exclusions do not apply on the lock screen.
Restore appearance, placement, gestures, and panels. Keep the name and enable switch.
Place the panel beside the handle.
Back closes the panel. Handle gestures remain available.
Fixed panels do not scroll. Buttons beyond the limit remain saved.
All buttons remain available by scrolling. Use Test panel to check scrolling.
Buttons not shown: %1$d. Increase the limit or select Scrollable.
Screen limit: %1$d. Saved values are retained.
Preview buttons do not run actions. Test panel opens working controls.
The action failed. Check permissions and try again.
This app is unavailable. Edit the button to choose another app.
Allow Do Not Disturb access to use this sound control.
Do Not Disturb may remain on if another rule is active.
No static icons found in this pack.
Saved icon pack is unavailable. Original icons are shown.
Backups include all handles and buttons, including hidden buttons. Icon packs must be installed separately.
Add independent copies with their switches off. Keep current global settings.
Replace all handles and global settings. Nudge will stay paused for review.
Configuration imported. Review the handles before enabling them.
The backup could not be read or written. Check the file and available storage.
The backup exceeds the 1 MiB limit.
This configuration needs a different Nudge version. Saved data has been kept.
The configuration is invalid. Saved data has been kept.
Settings could not be read. Saved data has been kept. Select Retry to try again.
Changes are visible but not saved. Check storage and select Retry.
Open Settings → Additional settings → Accessibility → Downloaded apps → Nudge handles. Enable the service.
If Android blocks Accessibility, open Nudge App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Return to Accessibility and enable Nudge.
Enable Nudge under Settings → Apps → Permissions → Background autostart. Some builds list Autostart under Apps or Security → Permissions.
Autostart is recommended on HyperOS. Nudge cannot verify this setting. Menu names vary by build.
Try App info → Battery saver → No restrictions. Keep current battery settings if Nudge stays connected.
Try Security → Settings → Boost speed → Lock apps → Nudge. Some builds also support locking Nudge in Recents.
If the service disconnects, copy diagnostics before switching Nudge off and on in Accessibility. Force-stop or revoked permissions require manual recovery.
Handles work while the screen is awake. Nudge does not keep the phone awake. Check battery use after changing HyperOS restrictions.
Include published test versions when checking for updates.
Tap Check for updates to contact GitHub.
No matching release was found. Enable testing to include pre-releases.
You have the latest matching release: %1$s.
The update check failed. Check your connection or view releases on GitHub.
GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later or view releases.
GitHub blocked this check. Try again later or view releases.
Public Nudge releases could not be found on GitHub.
GitHub is unavailable. Try again later.
The release data could not be read. Try again later or view releases.
The response was too large. View releases on GitHub.
This version could not be compared. View releases on GitHub.
No APK is attached to this release. Open the release notes to check its files.
Release APKs install separately from this debug app.
No browser is available to open this link.
Diagnostics copied. Add the HyperOS version and observed test results.
A handle or panel could not be shown. Re-enable Accessibility and check diagnostics.
Phone preview. Drag the touch area or use Center along edge to move it.
Unavailable in the current screen state
Turn off Follow handle to drag the panel. The position sliders provide the same control.
